hero.description: Hel fursado maalgashi oo casri ah oo kaa caawinaya kobcinta hantidaada, kuwaas oo ku habboon maalgashadayaasha cusub iyo kuwa khibradda leh.

about.label: Nagu Saabsan
about.title: Maxaa Noo Dooranaysaa?
about.description: Waxaan bixinnaa madal hufan oo kharashkeedu macquul yahay, kuna shaqaysa tiknoolajiyad casri ah iyo taageero macaamiil oo joogto ah. Hadafkeennu waa inaan abuurno jawi lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ay maalgashadayaasha iyo ganacsatada heer kasta oo khibrad ah ku heli karaan fursado maaliyadeed oo casri ah.

accountOpening.label: Bilow
accountOpening.title: Aan Furanno Akoonkaaga
accountOpening.description: Ku bilow dhowr daqiiqo gudahood adigoo adeegsanaya hab isdiiwaangelin fudud oo ammaan ah. Samee akoonkaaga, dooro qorshaha maalgashiga, oo qaad tallaabada ugu horreysa ee ku aaddan yoolalkaaga maaliyadeed.
accountOpening.stepOne: Marka hore, samee akoonkaaga oo dooro qorshaha maalgashiga kugu habboon.
accountOpening.stepTwo: Kadib, samee lacag-bixinta si aad u hawlgeliso maalgashigaaga.
accountOpening.stepThree: Marka lacagtaada la xaqiijiyo, maalgashigaagu wuu bilaaban karaa.

finalCta.label: Bilow
finalCta.title: Diyaar Ma U Tahay Inaad Bilowdo Maalgashiga?
finalCta.description: Furitaanka akoonku wuxuu qaadanayaa wax ka yar 3 daqiiqo. Samee akoonkaaga maanta oo qaad tallaabada xigta ee safarkaaga maalgashi.
finalCta.imageAlt: Diyaar u noqo inaad bilowdo maalgashiga

about.label: Nagu Saabsan
about.description: Waxaan diiradda saarnaa inaan maalgashiga iyo ganacsiga ka dhigno kuwo fudud, la heli karo, oo hufan. Madashayada waxaa loogu talagalay maalgashadayaasha cusub iyo kuwa khibradda leh, iyadoo siinaysa jawi sahlan oo lagu sahamin karo fursadaha maaliyadeed laguna kobcin karo kalsooni.

leadership.label: Hoggaanka
leadership.title: Fariin ka timid Agaasimaha Guud
leadership.message: Ha ka welwelin haddii aadan weli wax walba aqoon. Ka bilow meesha aad joogto, sii wad barashada, oo kobci aqoontaada intaad waddada ku jirto. Tallaabo kasta oo aad u qaaddo dhinaca maalgashigu waxay kaa caawin kartaa inaad dhisto aqoon, khibrad, iyo kalsooni safarkaaga maaliyadeed.
leadership.name: Tebo

whatIsInvesting.title: Waa maxay maalgashigu?
whatIsInvesting.description: Maalgashigu waa ficilka ah in lacag ama hanti lagu geliyo wax la filayo inuu faa'iido keeno ama qiimihiisu kordho waqti ka dib. Tani waxay ka mid noqon kartaa saamiyo, curaarta, guryaha, ama ganacsiyada si loo gaaro koboc maaliyadeed mustaqbalka.

investmentTypes.title: Waa maxay noocyada kala duwan ee maalgashiga?
investmentTypes.description: Noocyada caadiga ah ee maalgashiga waxaa ka mid ah saamiyada, curaarta, sanduuqyada maalgashiga, hantida ma-guurtada ah, badeecooyinka, iyo maalgashiyo kale sida lacagaha dijitaalka ah. Nooc kasta wuxuu leeyahay heer khatar iyo fursad faa'iido oo u gaar ah, waxaana faylalka maalgashigu isku dari karaa dhowr nooc oo hanti ah.

howToStart.title: Sideen u bilaabi karaa maalgashiga?
howToStart.description: Marka hore, samee akoon madasha. Kadib dooro qorshaha maalgashiga aad rabto oo samee lacag-bixinta si aad u bilowdo maalgashigaaga.

Footer.description: Xalal maalgashi oo fudud oo la heli karo, loogu talagalay dadka doonaya inay dhistaan mustaqbalkooda maaliyadeed.
Footer.contactDescription: Ma qabtaa su'aal ama waxaad u baahan tahay caawimaad? Si toos ah ula xiriir kooxda taageerada.
Footer.riskNotice: Maalgashigu wuxuu leeyahay khatar. Waxqabadkii hore ma dammaanad qaadayo natiijooyinka mustaqbalka.

Notifications.label: Ogeysiisyada
Notifications.title: Wax ogeysiis cusub ah ma jiro
Notifications.description: Hadda ma jiraan ogeysiisyo cusub. Waan ku soo ogeysiin doonaa marka ay jiraan wax muhiim ah oo u baahan dareenkaaga.

Terms.title: Shuruudaha & Xaaladaha
Terms.intro: Fadlan si taxaddar leh u akhri shuruudahan ka hor intaadan isticmaalin madasha Somalia Malgashi iyo adeegyada ay bixiso.

introduction.title: 1. Hordhac
introduction.content: Ku soo dhawoow Somalia Malgashi. Markaad gasho ama isticmaasho boggayaga iyo adeegyadayada, waxaad oggolaanaysaa inaad u hoggaansanto Shuruudahan & Xaaladaha. Haddii aadan ku raacsanayn shuruudahan, fadlan ha isticmaalin adeegyadayada.

accountRegistration.title: 2. Diiwaangelinta Akoonka
accountRegistration.content: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u baahato inaad samaysato akoon si aad u isticmaasho adeegyada qaarkood. Adiga ayaa mas'uul ka ah bixinta xog sax ah iyo ilaalinta xogta gelitaanka akoonkaaga.

investmentTrading.title: 3. Maalgashi & Ganacsi
investmentTrading.content: Dhammaan hawlaha maalgashiga iyo ganacsigu waxay leeyihiin khatar. Macluumaadka lagu soo bandhigo madashayada waxaa loogu talagalay ujeeddooyin guud oo xog-bixin ah, mana aha dammaanad faa'iido ama talo maaliyadeed.

paymentsWithdrawals.title: 4. Lacag-bixinta & Lacag-la-bixidda
paymentsWithdrawals.content: Adiga ayaa mas'uul ka ah inaad hubiso in xogta lacag-bixinta iyo lacag-la-bixidda aad bixiso ay sax tahay. Waqtiga habaynta iyo shuruudaha lagu dabaqi karo way kala duwanaan karaan iyadoo ku xiran adeegga la isticmaalo.

userResponsibilities.title: 5. Mas'uuliyadaha Isticmaalaha
userResponsibilities.content: Waxaad oggolaanaysaa inaad madasha u isticmaasho si sharci ah oo masuuliyad leh. Waa inaadan isku dayin inaad carqalad ku samayso shaqada madasha, gasho akoonka isticmaale kale, ama adeegga u isticmaasho khiyaano ama hawlo aan la oggolayn.

limitationOfLiability.title: 6. Xaddidaadda Mas'uuliyadda
limitationOfLiability.content: Ilaa xadka uu sharcigu oggol yahay, Somalia Malgashi kama mas'uul noqon doonto khasaaraha ka dhasha xaaladaha suuqa, ciladaha farsamo, ama duruufo kale oo ka baxsan awooddayada macquulka ah.

changesToTerms.title: 7. Isbeddellada Shuruudahan
changesToTerms.content: Waxaan mararka qaarkood cusboonaysiin karnaa Shuruudahan & Xaaladaha. Isbeddel kasta wuxuu dhaqan gelayaa marka lagu daabaco boggan. Sii wadista isticmaalka madasha kadib marka isbeddellada la daabaco waxay ka dhigan tahay inaad aqbashay shuruudaha la cusbooneysiiyay.

privacy.label: Asturnaanta
privacy.title: Siyaasadda Asturnaanta
privacy.intro: Qaybtani waxay sharxaysaa sida Somalia Malgashi u ururin karto, u isticmaali karto, una ilaalin karto macluumaadka lagu bixiyo madashayada.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Macluumaadka Aan Ururino
informationWeCollect.content: Waxaan ururin karnaa macluumaadka aad bixiso markaad samaysanayso akoon, nala soo xiriirayso, ama isticmaalayso adeegyadayada. Tani waxay ku jiri kartaa magacaaga, macluumaadka xiriirka, xogta akoonka, iyo macluumaad kale oo lagama maarmaan u ah bixinta adeegyadayada.

howWeUseInformation.title: 2. Sida Aan U Isticmaalno Macluumaadka
howWeUseInformation.content: Macluumaadka waxaa loo isticmaali karaa bixinta iyo horumarinta adeegyada, xiriirka isticmaalayaasha, ilaalinta amniga akoonnada, habaynta codsiyada, iyo buuxinta shuruudaha sharci ama hawleed ee lagu dabaqi karo.

informationProtection.title: 3. Ilaalinta Macluumaadka
informationProtection.content: Waxaan qaadnaa tallaabooyin macquul ah si aan u ilaalinno macluumaadka lagu ururiyo madashayada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma jiro hab gudbin ama kaydin elektaroonig ah oo lagu dammaanad qaadi karo inuu gebi ahaanba ammaan yahay.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.content: Boggeennu wuxuu isticmaali karaa cookies ama teknoolojiyado la mid ah si loo ilaaliyo fadhiyada isticmaalaha, loo hagaajiyo shaqaynta, loona fahmo sida isticmaalayaashu ula falgalaan madasha.

thirdPartyServices.title: 5. Adeegyada Dhinacyada Saddexaad
thirdPartyServices.content: Madashayadu waxay isticmaali kartaa adeegyo dhinac saddexaad ah si ay u taageeraan lacag-bixinta, xaqiijinta, falanqaynta, martigelinta, ama hawlo kale. Adeegyadani waxay u habayn karaan macluumaadka si waafaqsan siyaasadaha asturnaanta ee iyaga u gaarka ah.

yourRights.title: 6. Xuquuqdaada
yourRights.content: Iyadoo ku xiran sharciyada lagu dabaqi karo, waxaad yeelan kartaa xuquuq la xiriirta macluumaadka aan kaa hayno, oo ay ku jirto inaad codsato helitaan, sixid, ama tirtiridda macluumaad gaar ah.

contact.title: 7. Xiriir
contact.content: Haddii aad qabto su'aalo ku saabsan Shuruudahan & Xaaladahan ama Siyaasaddan Asturnaanta, fadlan la xiriir kooxda taageeradayada.
